```{bash}
cd ../data

/srlab/programs/ncbi-datasets-v13.34.0/datasets \
download genome accession GCF_022539355.2

```
```{bash}
cd ../data
unzip ncbi_dataset.zip
```

```{bash}
mkdir ../data/genome
cp ../data/ncbi_dataset/data/GCF_022539355.2/GCF_022539355.2_HSTE1.2_genomic.fna ../data/genome/GCF_022539355.2_HSTE1.2_genomic.fa
```


```{bash}
# Directories and programs
bismark_dir="/srlab/programs/Bismark-0.24.2"
bowtie2_dir="/srlab/programs/bowtie2-2.5.4-sra-linux-x86_64/"
genome_folder="../data/genome/"

${bismark_dir}/bismark_genome_preparation \
--verbose \
--parallel 24 \
--path_to_aligner ${bowtie2_dir} \
${genome_folder}
```


```{bash}

# Directories and programs
bismark_dir="/srlab/programs/Bismark-0.24.2"
bowtie2_dir="/srlab/programs/bowtie2-2.5.4-sra-linux-x86_64/"
genome_folder="/mmfs1/home/sr320/github/Claudia-Halibut/project/data/genome/"
reads_dir="/mmfs1/gscratch/scrubbed/sr320/RRBS-run2/raw-data/"


find ${reads_dir}*_R1.fq.gz \
| xargs basename -s _R1.fq.gz | xargs -I{} ${bismark_dir}/bismark \
--path_to_bowtie ${bowtie2_dir} \
-genome ${genome_folder} \
-p 4 \
- u 10000 \
-score_min L,0,-0.6 \
--non_directional \
-1 ${reads_dir}{}_R1.fq.gz \
-2 ${reads_dir}{}_R2.fq.gz \
-o ../output/01-test

```
